newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey puts share-dealing limits on brokerages.
newsitem.headline: Turkey puts share-dealing limits on brokerages.

text.p: The Capital Markets Board (SPK) said on Thursday that it would apply new rules from January 2 to achieve a balance between the capital of brokerages and the volume of their share transactions.
A single buy or sell order of a brokerage will be limited to 25 percent of its capital, the statement, signed by SPK chairman Ali Ihsan Karacan, said.
The total volume of buy or sell orders will be limited to four times a brokerage's capital. This can be exceeded by five percent at most when orders cannot be split.
The new regulations will not apply to the wholesale market where block share deals are made, the SPK said.
